text:
emma: quick flag  Sentinel onboarding shows p95 spikes on /v2/compare over the last week. renewal check-in in 11 days. we need an evidence bundle + provisional credit calc. :warning:
ryan: can you paste the contract SLOs and the recent metrics? will scope infra asks
emma: SLA: 99.9% uptime; SLO: 95% requests < 250ms on /v2/compare. last 7d: uptime 99.93%, p50=90ms, p95=480ms, p99=950ms. breach pattern: 3 days with p95>250ms, two of which are business days.
priya: legal: remember to mark any customer-facing numbers as "provisional" and include audit window + data sources. also we need explicit language re: mitigation credits being adjusted after verification.
nathan: ops: initial look shows increased cache eviction and one model fallback event (fp16->int8) on two nights. i'll pull traces + fallback logs. bundle should include: 1-page summary, timeline of events, metrics CSV, top traces, infra events, and credit calc spreadsheet.
ryan: commands i'll run to gather data:
```
redwood metrics export --service inference --route "/v2/compare" --since 7d --agg p50,p95,p99,uptime --by day > sentinel-metrics.csv
redwood traces query --route "/v2/compare" --filter "latency>300" --limit 30 > sentinel-traces.ndjson
redwood infra events --since 7d --filter "cache_eviction OR model_fallback" > sentinel-infra.log
```
nathan: i'll attach top 5 traces and the model fallback stack traces. early hypothesis: bursty QPS + cache churn during a deployment window.
priya: for comms text please include provisional credit calc and two scenarios: (A) no remediation, (B) remediation reduces breach days. legal requires explicit placeholders for token counts and final audit clause.
emma: agreed. target bundle contents + owners: emma (customer note + consolidate), nathan (traces + infra timeline), ryan (metrics CSV + credit calc template), priya (legal language). deadline: 48h for CSM review.
slo-bot: automated: 2026-05-10T02:45Z - p95 exceeded 250ms on 3 days in rolling 7d. incident ticket CS-4102 opened: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CS-4102
sentinel-contact: thanks for the heads-up. we can run a 20min synthetic ramp tomorrow morning if that helps test warmup.
ryan: warmup + prefix caching are low-risk. we can toggle prefix cache in canary for 24h and spin up one warm replica to reduce cold misses. will schedule at 03:30 UTC tonight.
priya: legal asks that we avoid promising to withhold credits until results are verified. wording: "Provisional credit will be calculated and held pending audit of the metrics and traces referenced in the annex." i'll paste suggested clause in the doc.
emma: communication plan draft: 1) short summary of what we observed, 2) what we're doing (canary + suggested customer synthetic), 3) provisional credit estimate and explanation of how it's calculated, 4) next steps + timeline to final verification.
ryan: provisional credit calc formula (draft): (breach_days / 7) * monthly_commitment * credit_rate. will add tokens and request counts per breach day.
nathan: added note: model fallback to int8 causes tail increases; include kernel logs and fallback timestamps so legal/ops can verify.
sentinel-contact: confirming synthetic at 08:00 local (12:00 UTC) tomorrow. we'll also provide a token-size sample.
emma: sweet. action items recap: ryan -> export metrics + calc; nathan -> traces + fallback logs; priya -> provisional language; emma -> assemble bundle and draft customer email. i'll send to legal for signoff before outreach. any blockers?
priya: none. please include CSVs and trace ids for audit.
emma: thanks everyone. closing note: if canary + synthetic drop p95 below 250ms within 48h we'll propose reduced credit; otherwise proceed with provisional credit and next-step remediation. filing to renewal tracker as "at-risk (monitoring)". :white_check_mark:
